title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
claim_used: PPO alternates environment sampling with multiple epochs of surrogate-objective updates; this study freezes one sampling generation per batch.
relevance: Baseline algorithm identity; exact density and on-policy bookkeeping.
limitation: Paper benchmark claims do not establish performance in this rehab simulation; current single committed plan has one high-level decision per episode.
design_decision: Use clipped surrogate and preserve behavior-generation ownership; do not claim new algorithm or reuse incompatible old actor semantics.
